title: Comparison Of Video-based Versus Written Patient Education on Sunscreen
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the effect of video-based patient education with written instruction on subjects' adherence to sunscreen application.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years of age or older at time of consent, may be men or women.
* Able to adhere to the study visit schedule and other protocol requirements.
* Capable of giving informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non-English speaking individuals
* Individuals with a known allergy to sunscreens
* Individuals with a history of psoriasis, because phototherapy has been shown to be beneficial for their skin condition
